problem: University students struggle to find compatible study groups for their specific courses, schedules, and learning preferences, leading to isolated studying and lower academic performance.
target_user: University students looking for academic peers to collaborate with on specific courses.
goals: Enable students to create profiles and specify their enrolled courses.
Match students based on course overlap, schedule availability, and study style preferences.
Provide a basic in-app messaging or contact mechanism for matched students to coordinate.
non_goals: Building a paid or premium tier for advanced matching features.
Integrating with official university LMS APIs (due to no paid APIs and authorization complexity).
Real-time video conferencing or file storage hosting.
requirements: Users must be able to register and log in using a university email domain.
Users must be able to input their course schedule and weekly availability.
Users must be able to select a study style preference (e.g., quiet, discussion-based, quiz-heavy).
The system must compute and display a list of compatible study partners.
Users must be able to send connection requests and message accepted peers.

user_stories.i_want: to create an account using my university email
user_stories.so_that: I can access the study group platform securely and verify my student status
acceptance_criteria: Registration form accepts valid university email domains
User is redirected to profile setup upon successful registration

user_stories.i_want: to input my current courses and weekly availability
user_stories.so_that: the system knows what subjects I need help with and when I am free
acceptance_criteria: User can add multiple courses by course code and name
User can select free hours via a weekly calendar grid interface
Profile updates save successfully to the database

user_stories.i_want: to select my preferred study style
user_stories.so_that: I am matched with peers who have compatible working habits
acceptance_criteria: User can choose from predefined study styles (e.g., visual, collaborative, quiet)
Preferences are stored in the user profile
Preferences can be edited at any time

user_stories.i_want: to view a list of recommended study partners matching my courses and availability
user_stories.so_that: I can easily find people to study with without manually searching
acceptance_criteria: Algorithm calculates overlap in courses, available time slots, and study style
Matches are displayed in a ranked list
User can view basic profile details of potential matches

user_stories.i_want: to send a connection request and message matched peers
user_stories.so_that: we can coordinate meeting times and study locations
acceptance_criteria: User can send, accept, or reject connection requests
Connected users can exchange direct messages within the app
All core features must be functional across modern desktop and mobile web browsers.
The application must handle basic form validation and error states gracefully.
User data must be securely stored without exposing personal emails to unverified users.

risks.description: Matching algorithm performance or accuracy may be difficult to tune effectively within the short timeframe.
Low initial user adoption on campus could make matching ineffective during testing.
Team coordination issues over the 5-week timeline leading to incomplete features.
